svg.aria-label: Fleet Size by Navy — Line diagram
svg.style: background: rgb(236, 239, 244); font-family: Inter, system-ui, Avenir, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
svg.desc: Line chart of 4 series, Royal Navy, French Navy, Spanish Navy and Dutch Navy, over 6 points, from 1690 to 1740; values range from 33 to 131.
